sources.name: AURCADE
sources.example_data_quote: Underground Retrocade, West Dundee IL: Games: 213. Machine list via /services/ws_games.aspx?a=lg&id=1397 includes Jubeat (Konami, 2012) plus full classic video/pinball floor (Donkey Kong, Galaga, Asteroids, etc.). Dance Dance Revolution Extreme page lists 162 public locations worldwide, majority US (e.g. Acton Bowladrome MA, Aftershock Classic Arcade WI, Ground Kontrol OR). Galloping Ghost Arcade id=638: Games 1101, Unique 306, updated 2026-07-29.
sources.adds_over_current: Strongest US classic/video arcade machine database not already wired. Map is ZIv-heavy for US (1432/1473 src=ziv) and misses flagship classic venues (Galloping Ghost, Funspot absent). Aurcade can (1) add missing classic mega-venues with full cab lists, (2) upgrade other-only ZIv stubs that have DDR/PIU/jubeat on Aurcade but only redemption/other on map (example: Acton Bowladrome is other-only on map; Aurcade lists DDR Extreme there), (3) expand classic cab detail beyond music games. Weak on modern Bemani/ALL.Net (CHUNITHM, SDVX, maimai) relative to ZIv/Round1; strength is classic + older DDR/PIU/jubeat floors.
sources.note: HTML location pages + scrapable endpoint /services/ws_games.aspx?a=lg&id={location_id}. Genre filters include Dance/Rhythm, Music, Rhythm. Recent scores dated 2026-08-03. Venue total not published as a single number; hundreds of US locations confirmed via game-location reverse indexes (DDR Extreme alone: 162). Not a rhythm-first wiki; better treated as classic-arcade + occasional music cabs.

sources.name: Museum of the Game / International Arcade Museum (Arcade Map)
sources.example_data_quote: Site reports 'All available locations: 3054' (live 2026-08-04). Galloping Ghost Arcade page: address 9415 Ogden Ave Brookfield IL, hours Sun-Thur 11am-12am Fri-Sat 11am-2am, '1075 Video Games', payment Hourly, verified; long 'Games Reportedly Operated Include' table (005, 1941 Counter Attack, 1942, ... On Floor status). Chain list includes Dave & Busters 156, Barcade 11, Round 1 9, Emporium 5, Cidercade 5, etc.
sources.adds_over_current: Largest open US-heavy public arcade locator with per-venue classic game lists, hours, payment, and chain grouping. Adds venues the map lacks entirely (Galloping Ghost, Funspot top most-visited; both missing from arcades.json). Game focus is classic video/pinball/redemption, not modern rhythm. Overlap with ZIv on barcades/family centers is partial; value is classic mega-arcades and closed/verified status flags. Common-games page shows Guitar Hero Arcade in top 50 (5 locations) but not modern Bemani.
sources.note: URL pattern /location/{State}/{Name-City-id}. Related: /location/chain/list, /location/most-visited-list, /location/common-games. Same org as KLOV. Filter UI supports Has Game name search. Data timestamped on pages (e.g. most-visited 'August 04 2026').

sources.name: Arcade Map (arcademap.app / BlueBurst)
sources.example_data_quote: List page: '213 of 213 venues' with country filter including United States. Galloping Ghost page: 'Arcade 1021 machines', address 9415 Ogden Ave Brookfield IL, full alphabetical games table (1000 Miglia through ...). Round1 Burbank page live but 'Games 0 / No games listed for this venue yet' - coverage uneven. Photos via sql.marshweb.co.nz API paths.
sources.adds_over_current: Smaller than Aurcade/IAM but structured slug URLs and some deep classic game lists. Majority of listed venues appear US (Round1 stores, barcades, Emporium, Coin-Op Game Room, Main Event, etc.). Can surface venues or classic cab detail missing from ZIv stubs; does not systematically beat Round1/ZIv on modern rhythm for stores that already have those sources. Many chain entries have empty game lists.
sources.note: Formerly linked as blueburst.gg/arcades/ (redirects here). Android app on Google Play. Community-edit model. Pinball intentionally out of scope (defers to Pinball Map).

sources.name: Pinball Map
sources.example_data_quote: Homepage (live 2026-08-03 crawl context / site claims): 12,624 locations and 54,502 machines. Open-source crowdsourced pinball locator with documented REST API at /api/v1/docs (API token required as of 2026; /api/v1/locations/:id/machine_details.json returns 401 without token). Regional maps (e.g. /la).
sources.adds_over_current: World-class machine-level data and API quality, but pinball-only. Does not fill music-game Other-only stubs. Useful only if map ever tracks pinball or wants co-located venues that also host music cabs; not a rhythm source.
sources.note: Include for completeness as the best US public coin-op map infrastructure; not recommended as primary for rhythm/arcade music games. Token gate since mid-2026.

sources.name: Barcade official locations + games
sources.example_data_quote: Site claims: 'Explore the full list of classic arcade games and pinball machines available at each Barcade location.' Locations nav: Brooklyn, Detroit, Jersey City, Los Angeles, New Haven, New York Chelsea, New York FiDi, New York St. Marks Place, plus others. Marketing copy confirms per-location game lists; SPA rendered pages returned little static HTML on fetch (JS-heavy).
sources.adds_over_current: Chain already partly on map via ZIv (e.g. Barcade FiDi and Center City Philadelphia with chunithm/groove_coaster/other). Official per-location classic lists could correct or enrich cab notes if scrapable; not a large new venue set. Rhythm coverage at Barcade is sparse vs classic video.
sources.note: Small chain (~11). Use as operator-attested classic lists if JS content can be rendered; not a national rhythm database.

sources.name: Insert Coin (insert-coin.app)
sources.example_data_quote: App Store / Reddit (r/cade): free iOS/Android/web map for pinball, foosball, pool, darts, arcade; maintainers claimed ~3,000 locations and 17,000 games. Web map is a JS SPA: WebFetch returned no indexable game/venue body. Arcade Heroes directory lists it as NEW Dec 2024.
sources.adds_over_current: Potentially large venue+game graph, but machine-readable access not confirmed today (SPA, no public API found). Scope is bar/cafe games as much as music arcades. Unverified for US rhythm cab depth until app/API inspected further. Do not treat as proven hkarcade-class source yet.
sources.note: Still live (app + domain respond). Mark machine_readable manual_only until a scrape/API path is demonstrated. Priority below Aurcade and Museum of the Game.

sources.name: Dave & Buster's official location finder
sources.example_data_quote: Full US state list of store pages (AL Birmingham through WI Wauwatosa, 100+ US stores) live 2026-08-04. Per-store pages are address/hours/reservations oriented; no public per-location music or full game inventory on the locator.
sources.adds_over_current: Operator-attested store list for a major chain. Does not supply music-game cabinets. Low value for Other-only rhythm enrichment unless combined with community reports. Museum of the Game already tracks ~156 D&B entries with some classic game data.
sources.note: Locator only. Main Event / similar FEC chains are the same class (store finder, no cab lists).

summary: Searched English (and US community terms: arcade bar, barcade, DDR/Bemani locations, Aurcade, KLOV, pinball map, Insert Coin). Opened and verified live pages on 2026-08-04. Compared against arcades.json: 1473 US venues, 236 other-only, sources dominated by ziv (1432) with allnet/round1usa secondary. There is no US equivalent of hkarcade.fandom.com (a dedicated multi-venue rhythm/music-game wiki with full cab lists). Reddit r/DanceDanceRevolution and r/bemani still point people to Zenius-i-Vanisher for music arcades. Best new structured sources are classic-arcade databases: (1) AURCADE with per-location machine lists and a scrapable ws_games endpoint, including DDR Extreme reverse-index of 162 locations and confirmation of music cabs like jubeat at Underground Retrocade; (2) Museum of the Game Arcade Map with 3054 locations, hours, and on-floor game tables (Galloping Ghost, Funspot, etc. absent from current map); (3) arcademap.app with 213 venues and deep classic lists when populated. Pinball Map is excellent API infrastructure but pinball-only. Insert Coin is live and large by claim but not machine-readable from static fetch. Official Round1 USA locator already used; D&B/Main Event locators lack cab lists. Highest practical ROI for US other-only / missing venues: Aurcade + Museum of the Game for classic floors and occasional DDR/PIU/jubeat; do not expect them to replace ZIv/ALL.Net for modern Bemani.
dead_ends: arcadelocations.net (Classic Arcade Game Location) failed to fetch (connection error). bemanistyle.com is content/blog, not a multi-venue cab database. Highway Games is parts/commercial directory, not a venue map. r/DanceDanceRevolution 'canonical near me' threads restate ZIv rather than a separate maintained spreadsheet. Ground Kontrol official site is single-venue events/news, not multi-venue. Barcade /games and Insert Coin map are JS-heavy (thin static content). Pinball Map API requires token (401 without). blueburst.gg redirects to arcademap.app (not a separate source). No verified US Google Sheet/wiki systematically listing modern CHUNITHM/SDVX/maimai outside ZIv/Round1/ALL.Net. Google Maps/Yelp deliberately not treated as sources.
